title: RunnerLease
description:
A runner lease granting scoped filesystem access to a runner
(decomposition §1, item 5).

Frozen by WP-00.

expiry.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at which this lease expires.

net_policy.description: Network policy name / ref governing this runner's outbound access.

path_set.description: Set of filesystem paths this lease grants access to.

principal_chain.description:
Ordered chain of principals (agent ids / user ids) that own this
lease.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease.

tmp_root.description: Temporary root directory allocated to this runner.

RunnerState.description: Lifecycle state of a runner lease.

oneOf.description: Lease is currently held and active.
Runner crashed while holding the lease.
